options: Every element of $A$ is also an element of $B$.
Every element of $B$ is also an element of $A$.
$A$ and $B$ have no elements in common.
questions.explanation: A being a subset of B means every element of A is also an element of B.

questions.question: What does transitivity of subset relations mean?
options: If $A\subseteq B$, then $C\subseteq A$ for every set $C$.
If $A\subseteq B$ and $B\subseteq C$, then $A\subseteq C$.
questions.explanation: Transitivity of subset: if A is a subset of B and B is a subset of C, then A is a subset of C.
